thread:
miranda: Quick PM follow-up  propose two things: 1) a central action board (owners/due/verifier) 2) short IC rotation + comms cadence doc. comments?

alex_m: +1. Suggested board columns: Backlog / Assigned / In progress / Blocked / Complete / Verified.

alex_m: Timeline template to add to tickets:
- incident timeline (detect -> mitigate -> rc)
- immediate mitigations (who/when)
- postmortem owner
- actions: Action / Owner / Due / Priority / Status / Verifier
- recurrence check window (30/60/90d)

sam_dev: Comms cadence: initial public note within 10m by IC, updates every 30m until stable, final summary in #incidents. Draft PM within 72h, final within 7d.

paul_s: IC rotation: 1-week IC tied to oncall, named backup. Put roster in Confluence + calendar reminders. Avoid assigning new hires their 1st week. Also capture recurring patterns monthly.

incident-bot: Created ticket RED-INC-ACT-2026 and assigned to miranda :ticket:

natacha: Add recurrence tags on PMs (network/scaling/regression/config). We can surface trends in Console; monthly trend review sounds good.

miranda: Can @alex_m create the Jira board + import template? Proposed SLAs: P1=14d, P2=30d, P3=90d. Weekly 30m PM review Thu 10:00.

alex_m: I'll create board and post link. Will add fields: "Incident recurrence risk" (low/med/high) and "Verifier".

sam_dev: I'll help define recurrence taxonomy and add watchers for product/security.

paul_s: Add a one-line test for each action so verifier knows what to check. I'll add checklist to runbook and link it.

miranda: Owners for initial rollout: alex_m (board+template), natacha (dashboard sketch), paul_s (verifier checklist), sam_dev (jira fields & watchers). Target: draft board + sketch in 3 days.

alex_m: Will post board link and sample tickets by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Reminder created: weekly PM review (eng-oncall) Thursdays 10:00 starting 2026-04-02

miranda: Thanks all. Goal: fewer lost actions and clearer ownership. We'll iterate after first week. :eyes:
